text: Release PRs in BielinskiLukasz/habits (lb-habits) are opened and merged immediately (within seconds), so code reviewer runs will always be retrospective — post as a comment, not an approval or change-request.
habits repo CI workflow (.github/workflows/ci.yml) was removed in PR #1 (v1.1.0); there is no automated node --test gate on pushes to main as of 2026-08-27.
